title: Renewing the Mind
definition: Renewing the Mind is the Spirit-led transformation of thought, desire, discernment, and obedience through God's truth.
summary: Renewing the Mind is the Spirit's transformation of the believer's thinking through the truth of God's Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ transforms His people by truth so they discern and do the will of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on how disciples learn to think differently. The mind is renewed as Scripture confronts lies, reshapes desires, reorders values, and teaches believers to discern God's will. Change reaches deeper than behavior when truth reforms perception.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because worldly patterns often feel normal until God's Word exposes them. Renewed thinking helps believers resist conformity, anxiety, bitterness, lust, pride, and despair. It also strengthens worship by teaching the mind to dwell on what is true.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Notice the thoughts that regularly govern your reactions. Replace lies with specific Scripture, not vague positivity. Build habits of reading, memorizing, and speaking truth until your responses begin to change.
